text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Starting off on our headlines for today...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Gold City, an Umamusume model known
to her
many fans as "Pretty City,"
recently announced
that she will
compete in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Gold City boasts a huge following
among the
teen demographic. I can't
wait to see what kind of
beautiful
running she has to show!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: In other news...

Today, Gold City begins training in
earnest.
Thanks to her popularity as a
model,
expectations are running high.

Making this silent promise to myself, I
feel ready
to do some great work, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! Am I really late?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I see...

Gold City arrives late for our meeting.
She seems
a little tense, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, dang it...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll get my warm-ups out of the way now.
Hold on
a sec.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that City standing over there?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oh, it is! Congrats on your debut, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh... Are you fans of mine?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We saw you on TV and wanted to
come say
congratulations in person!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is unreal! You're so pretty in
person!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the support, but I'm in the
middle
of training right now...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: There she is! City's actually here! Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh boy... What now?
Hey, you're blockin' da way. Move!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah! Tamamo...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
City, don'tcha got trainin' now too?
What're ya
doin' wastin' your time here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, guys, I have to go. Watch me in
my race,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Please do your best!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that, Tamamo, but thank
you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're too nice to your fans. Your
debut's comin'
up, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya hafta learn how'ta better maneuver
through
the attention! I'll see ya, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She actually gave me advice...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross. She's a year above me,
but we'll
both be making our Twinkle
Series debut this
year.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, it's like... on one hand, she's more

experienced than me, but we're also sort
of on
the same level.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's get to training. I've already
lost so
much time...
Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, you've got to be—

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City, you there? Is now a good time? I
need to
tell you something about
yesterday's photo
shoot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I said not to bother me when I'm on
campus! Just
send me an email!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
How many times do I need to tell her? I
just want
to focus on training...

Gold City appears increasingly
aggravated. I
doubt she'll be able to
train efficiently if we start
now. With
that in mind...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, what, I should clear my mind and just
run till
I'm satisfied?

I tell her not to worry about distance or
time. I
want her to run until she feels
content.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What is this? Because I was late, you
don't want
to do a proper training
session anymore?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Okay, fine. You're the trainer here, so
whatever
you say, boss.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to improve though!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Raaaaaah!

Gold City runs as if venting her
frustration. She
frantically bulldozes
ahead, ignoring her
surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...

Her figure appears like sparkling gold.
It's a
beautiful sight.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Haaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I ran off everything that was bothering
me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
For being late. I'm so not a morning
person, and
then yesterday's modeling
job left me exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But I can't complain when I'm the one
who
decided to juggle both.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No problem. Still...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a huge pain for you if you always
adjust for
my convenience.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't like compromising, and I can be
selfish.
And I won't hide it when I'm
irritated either.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So you're 100% going to get fed up with
me at
some point... Would you still let
me run then?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I don't believe you. But I'll
have to if
we're going to get started.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's see what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I want you to sort out a schedule with
my
manager that'll let me prioritize
training.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh. How am I supposed to run till I'm
content if
you can't even handle this
much?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I need to show everyone I'm not just
some pretty
doll to be gawked at.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Show me that I can trust you, Trainer.
